era: 传说约 717 年生于邬金国（今巴基斯坦斯瓦特河谷，一说出生即无父无母、由莲花中生）——入印度那烂陀等大寺学显教，后师从八大持明者遍学密续——应赤松德赞之邀于约 776-780 年间入藏：沿路调伏苯教神灵为护法，助建桑耶寺并开显密双轨之制——为君臣二十五弟子等分层灌顶传法——传大圆满与八大法行，留椎击三要——预见教法超出现众消化力，将大量密法封存为伏藏并留授记——约八世纪末离藏赴西南罗刹国（传说），留下系列预记与'我还会再来'的承诺——身后被宁玛派尊为'第二佛'，莲师信仰遍布藏地与喜马拉雅诸国：《中阴闻教得度》等伏藏数百年间次第掘出，宁玛派以'三根本'（上师莲师、本尊、空行）立修法之中枢
era_en: By legend born c. 717 in Uddiyana (the Swat valley of today's Pakistan; some say wombless, born of a lotus)—studied exoteric doctrine at Nalanda and other great Indian monasteries, then mastered the tantras under eight vidyadhara masters—invited by Trisong Detsen, entered Tibet c. 776-780: subduing Bon deities into protectors along the way, aiding the building of Samye and instituting the dual sutra-tantra track—gave tiered empowerment to the twenty-five royal disciples and others—transmitted Dzogchen and the Eight Great Sadhana Cycles, leaving the three statements that strike the vital point—foreseeing that the teaching would exceed its audience's capacity, he sealed much of the esoteric corpus as terma with prophecies—departed for the rakshasa lands of the southwest c. the late eighth century (by legend), leaving a series of prophecies and the promise 'I shall return'—after his death honored by the Nyingma as 'the second Buddha,' his cult spreading across Tibet and the Himalayas: terma such as the Bardo Thodol were revealed one after another over centuries, and the Nyingma school made him the hub of the 'three roots' (guru Padmasambhava, yidam, dakini)
school: 藏传佛教宁玛派的奠基祖师（'宁玛'即'旧译'，尊莲师为教法之源）/ 伏藏（terma）制度的立法者（时间分层传承的设计者）/ 密续灌顶与三昧耶制度在西藏的系统化者 / 大圆满教法的主要传入者（椎击三要的口传者）/ 被尊为'咕噜仁波切'与'第二佛'的喜马拉雅信仰中枢
historical_significance: 莲花生（约717-800），邬金国出身（传说莲花化生），藏传佛教宁玛派奠基者，被尊为'第二佛'。他的历史地位由五件事锚定。其一，佛教在藏地的立足：应赤松德赞之邀入藏，沿路调伏苯教神灵为佛教护法——新教法借旧神灵的地方威望落地，避免了你死我活的宗教替换战。其二，显密双轨的制度设计：与寂护分工并立于桑耶寺——戒律与学问为地基、灌顶与实修为顶层，晋升门槛（灌顶）居中——藏传佛教千年的教会结构由此定型。其三，伏藏制度：预见教法超出现众消化力，把大量密法封存于岩、湖、心识并留授记指明未来掘藏者——宁玛派由此获得'自我更新机制'，《西藏度亡经》即伏藏产出。其四，大圆满与中阴教法的传入：'椎击三要'的直指方法论与中阴导引的阶段化手册，构成藏地心性学的双柱。其五，信仰制度的后续影响：莲师'八变'形象、上师相应法与伏藏掘出循环，使宁玛派在无中央权威下延续千年——一个以'封存-掘出'为节律的活体系。代价与极限：生平几乎全部被传说包裹（莲花化生、降魔神变、长寿数百），史实层仅能锚定赤松德赞时期入藏与桑耶寺的角色；'调伏'被苯教一方记为文化殖民；伏藏真伪之辨成为教团千年的认证难题。
historical_significance_en: Padmasambhava (c. 717-800), by legend born of a lotus in Uddiyana, founded the Nyingma school of Tibetan Buddhism and is honored as the 'second Buddha.' Five achievements anchor his standing. First, planting Buddhism in Tibet: invited by Trisong Detsen, he subdued Bon deities into Buddhist protectors along the way—the new teaching landed on the old gods' local prestige, avoiding a war of mutual annihilation. Second, the dual-track institution: working alongside Shantarakshita at Samye—discipline and scholarship as foundation, empowerment and practice as summit, the promotion gate (empowerment) between—the millennium-stable ecclesial structure of Tibetan Buddhism took shape. Third, the terma system: foreseeing the teaching would exceed its audience, he sealed esoteric texts in rock, lakes and minds with prophecies naming future revealers—giving Nyingma a self-renewal mechanism; the Tibetan Book of the Dead is terma output. Fourth, transmitting Dzogchen and the bardo teachings: the direct-pointing methodology of the 'three statements' and the staged navigation of the Bardo Thodol form the twin pillars of Tibetan mind-nature doctrine. Fifth, the downstream institution of belief: the Eight Manifestations, guru yoga and the concealment-revelation cycle let Nyingma endure a millennium without central authority—a living system pulsing to the rhythm of sealing and revelation. Costs and limits: his life is almost wholly wrapped in legend (lotus birth, demon subjugation, centuries of life); the historical layer anchors only his arrival under Trisong Detsen and his Samye role; 'subjugation' is recorded by Bon as cultural colonization; and authenticating terma became the school's millennium-long verification problem.
unique_thinking: 他思维方式的底色是'对时间与人心双层设防的传承工程：教法会超出现在的人，也会超出在场的人'。六个标志性动作。其一，'伏藏封存法'——预见接受者未备时把成果封存于体系自身的土壤（岩、湖、心识），预设解锁者与解锁条件：知识在时间中自我保管。其二，'顺缘调伏法'——内核不变而形态随受众改变：收编对方的神灵、按根器分层说法——适配而非说服。其三，'本尊相应法'——在受控想象中直接生成理想心智状态并暂时认同，再以次第拆除：先成为，再做出。其四，'双轨并立法'——戒律与密续、显与密不裁决而并行，共享门户与终点、以灌顶为晋升门槛。其五，'忿怒镇守法'——以更强的形态接管对方能量并收编为护法：被镇伏者成为承重结构而非边界外威胁。其六，'预记收束法'——离场时以预言完成最后部署：把风险、继任者画像与转机条件封入对未来的一揽子投递。代价与极限：伏藏真伪无法当场区分（认证依赖事后追认）；'按根器说法'若无诚实诊断即滑向操纵；生平传说化使史实层薄——他的方法论只能从其制度后果（伏藏体系、双轨结构、中阴文本）反向重构。
unique_thinking_en: The bedrock of his thinking: a transmission engineering doubly fortified against time and human hearts—the teaching will exceed the people of now, and the people on the spot. Six signature moves. First, terma concealment—foreseeing receivers not yet ready, seal the findings in the system's own soil (rock, lakes, minds), pre-designating unlocker and unlocking conditions: knowledge keeps itself across time. Second, affinity adaptation—unchanged core, form fitted to audience: enlisting the other's gods, teaching in layers by capacity—fitting, not persuading. Third, deity yoga—generating the ideal mental state directly in controlled imagination and identifying with it provisionally, then dismantling in stages: become first, act second. Fourth, the dual-track institution—discipline and tantra, sutra and esoteric, running in parallel without adjudication, sharing gate and destination with empowerment as the promotion gate. Fifth, wrathful subjugation—taking over the opponent's energy in a stronger form and conscripting it as protector: the subdued become load-bearing structure, not a threat beyond the border. Sixth, the prophetic exit—finishing the final deployment with prophecy: risks, successor profiles and renewal conditions sealed into one delivery to the future. Costs and limits: genuine and forged terma cannot be told apart on the spot (authentication is retroactive); 'teaching by capacity' without honest diagnosis slides into manipulation; and the legend-wrapped biography leaves a thin historical layer—his methodology can only be reconstructed from its institutional aftermath (the terma system, the dual-track structure, the bardo texts).

name_zh: 传承设计方法论/预见接受者尚未准备好时，把核心成果封存于系统自身的'土壤'中（文本、器物、心智、地理），预设未来的解锁者与解锁条件，让知识在时间中自我保管
name_en: transmission-design methodology/when the intended receivers are not yet ready, seal the core findings inside the system's own 'soil' (texts, objects, minds, geography), pre-designating the future unlocker and unlocking conditions so knowledge keeps itself across time
modes.domain_zh: 伏藏（terma）体系是莲花生留给西藏最具制度创造性的遗产。八世纪他入藏时面对一个冷峻的判断：佛教的完整教法超出了当时西藏社会的消化能力——贵族乱政、译经未备、根器参差，强行全量传授必然失真或引发反弹。他的解法不是减配传授，而是'时间分层'：把教法写成伏藏，封存于山岩、湖水、寺院梁柱，乃至弟子的心识中（愿藏），并伏藏 '授记'（lung bstan）指明：何年何月、何等征兆、由何地出生的何人（伏藏师，tertön）开启。伏藏师不是任意读者而是系统预埋的钥匙：每一部伏藏带有其开启者的印记，错人与错时都开不出。十三世纪以降，娘热·尼玛沃色、古如却旺等百余位伏藏师按授记次第掘出，宁玛派由此获得了其他教派没有的'自我更新机制'——教法不必依赖单一线索的延续，而是随需要从'土壤'中重新长出。《西藏度亡经》（中阴闻教得度）即出自噶玛林巴所掘伏藏。代价与极限：封存预设了'预知'的权威——授记的准确性只能事后追认，伪造伏藏与真伏藏在结构上无法当场区分，教团为此建立了认证制度但争议从未止息；且'未来会有人懂得'的信念若被滥用，就成了拒绝向当代人解释的借口。
modes.domain_en: The terma ('hidden treasure') system is Padmasambhava's most institutionally creative legacy. Entering Tibet in the eighth century, he faced a cold judgment: the full Buddhist teaching exceeded what Tibetan society could then digest—feuding aristocrats, an unfinished translation project, uneven aptitude—and forcing the whole transmission would distort it or provoke backlash. His solution was not a reduced teaching but 'temporal stratification': write the teaching as terma, seal it in rock, lakes, temple beams and even disciples' minds ('mind terma'), with a prophecy (lung bstan) specifying the year, the signs, and the person (the tertön, 'treasure revealer') born in such a place who will open it. The tertön is not an arbitrary reader but a key pre-embedded in the system: each terma bears the imprint of its intended opener, and the wrong person at the wrong time cannot open it. From the thirteenth century onward, more than a hundred tertön—Nyangral Nyima Ozer, Guru Chöwang and others—unearthed treasures in prophesied sequence, giving the Nyingma school a self-renewal mechanism no other school possessed: the teaching need not survive in a single lineage but can regrow from the 'soil' as needed. The Tibetan Book of the Dead (Bardo Thodol) is a revealed terma of Karma Lingpa. Costs and limits: concealment presupposes the authority of foresight—prophecies can only be ratified retroactively; forged and genuine terma are structurally indistinguishable on the spot, and though the school built an authentication system the disputes never ceased; and the faith that 'someone in the future will understand' can be abused as an excuse for refusing to explain to the present.

modes.definition_en: Transmission-design methodology/when findings exceed the present capacity to receive them, seal them inside the system's own carriers with a pre-designated unlocker and unlocking conditions—knowledge keeps itself across time instead of being force-delivered

modes.key_quote_zh: 今时未至，吾埋宝藏于岩、湖、心中；后世之人，依吾授记，当掘而出之。
modes.key_quote_en: The time is not yet: I bury the treasure in rock, lake and mind; a person of later ages, following my prophecy, shall dig it out.
process_zh: 评估接受时点：判断目标受众当下能否消化成果的完整形态——若不能，强行交付的损耗是什么？（失真、反弹、误用）
选择封存载体：把成果写入不易朽坏且与体系共生的介质——文本、器物、地理、制度惯例或成员心智，并让封存动作本身不留破坏性痕迹
预设解锁协议：写明'由谁、何时、凭何征兆'可开启——解锁者须与载体有可验证的绑定关系，且解锁条件不依赖封存者在场
授权自我保管：封存后不追问、不遥控——体系的当下形态接受能力边界，把完成品的命运交给已写好的未来
process_en: assess the moment of reception: can the intended audience digest the finding in full form now?—if not, what is the cost of force-delivery (distortion, backlash, misuse)?

choose the sealing carrier: write the finding into a durable, system-symbiotic medium—texts, objects, geography, institutional custom or members' minds—so the sealing itself leaves no destructive trace

pre-designate the unlocking protocol: specify by whom, when and upon what signs it may be opened—the unlocker must be verifiably bound to the carrier, and the conditions must not depend on the sealer's presence
authorize self-keeping: after sealing, do not micro-manage—the system's present form accepts its capacity boundary and hands the finished work to a future already written
representative_cases_zh: 莲花生八世纪入藏，见教法无法全量落地，遂将大量密法封存为伏藏，并留授记指明后世伏藏师——宁玛派千年传承由此不断自我更新
《西藏度亡经》于十四世纪由噶玛林巴按授记掘出，成为伏藏体系最著名的世界性产出——为临终与中阴阶段提供'使用手册'
《大宝伏藏》于十九世纪由蒋贡康楚辑成，把历代伏藏汇编为一百一十一卷——封存-掘出的循环被制度化为可检索的库
representative_cases_en: Entering Tibet in the eighth century, Padmasambhava judged the teaching could not land in full and sealed much of the esoteric corpus as terma with prophecies naming future revealers—the Nyingma school's millennium of self-renewal began there
The Tibetan Book of the Dead, unearthed by Karma Lingpa in the fourteenth century per prophecy, became the terma system's most famous world output—a manual for dying and the intermediate state
The Rinchen Terdzö, compiled by Jamgon Kongtrul in the nineteenth century, gathered the terma tradition into 111 volumes—the concealment-extraction cycle institutionalized as a searchable library
modern_applications_zh: 知识产权组合中的'睡眠专利'：技术超前于市场时封存专利并保留唤醒条件，等待产业成熟再启动——企业版伏藏
组织的'封存文档'制度：核心架构决策写入带触发条件的设计文档（'当用户量达到X时启用'），后任按条件解锁而非重新发明
开源项目的'长线分支'：把超前的实验性模块封存在分支中并写明启用条件与维护者画像，等待社区准备好时按图开启
modern_applications_en: 'Sleeping patents' in IP portfolios: when technology outpaces the market, seal the patent with wake-up conditions and activate on industry maturity—corporate terma
An organizational 'sealed documents' practice: core architectural decisions written into design docs with trigger conditions ('activate at X users'), so successors unlock rather than reinvent

Long-line branches in open-source: park experimental modules ahead of their time in branches with stated activation conditions and a maintainer profile, to be opened per the map when the community is ready

representative_figures.relation_zh: 最早的掘藏实践者（十二至十三世纪）——按授记掘出《上师密集意》等伏藏，验证了预埋解锁协议的可执行性
representative_figures.relation_en: the earliest practitioner of extraction (12th-13th c.)—unearthed termas such as the Guru Siddhi per prophecy, proving the embedded unlocking protocol executable

representative_figures.relation_zh: 十九世纪的伏藏汇编者（《大宝伏藏》）——把千年掘藏实践收拢为可检索的体系，是伏藏制度的'编目人'
representative_figures.relation_en: the nineteenth-century compiler of terma (Rinchen Terdzö)—consolidated a millennium of extraction into a searchable corpus, the system's cataloguer

name_zh: 传播沟通方法论/传播者不改变信息的内核而改变信息的形态：对每个受众的根器、语言与恐惧做诊断，再以对方能接受的形式重述同一核心——'调伏'不是说服而是适配
name_en: dissemination methodology/the transmitter changes the form of the message, not its core: diagnose each audience's capacity, language and fears, then restate the same core in a form they can accept—to 'subdue' is not to persuade but to fit
modes.domain_zh: 莲花生被尊为'调伏者'（藏语 Guru Rinpoche 的核心事迹即'调伏'）。他入藏后遇到的不是哲学对手而是文化环境：苯教的土著神灵、地方神山、王室的猜忌、民众对陌生的密续仪轨的恐惧。他的做法有两点极不寻常。其一，不拆对方的体系而是'收编'：苯教神灵不被宣布为伪，而被'调伏'为佛教的护法——原有的崇拜结构被保留，只是被重新委以角色。这使新宗教嫁接在旧宗教的情感基座上，避免了你死我活的替换战。其二，按根器分层说法：对国王讲王者的修行、对译师讲学理、对弟子讲密续、对普通人讲皈依与禁忌——同一教法以不同密度的形态存在，内核（皈依、菩提心、空性）不变。宁玛派文献中他有八种变化身（咕噜八变），每一种对应一类情境——形态的多样性本身就是方法论的展示。代价与极限：'收编'策略会被指控为机会主义（苯教至今视其为文化殖民）；'按根器说法'若失去诚实的根器诊断，就滑向对听众的操纵——给什么不讲什么，取决于而非对方的真实所需。
modes.domain_en: Padmasambhava is honored as 'the Subduer'—subduing is the core deed of Guru Rinpoche as Tibet tells it. What he met on entering Tibet was not a philosophical rival but a cultural environment: the indigenous gods of Bon, local mountain deities, royal suspicion, popular dread of unfamiliar tantric rites. His response had two unusual features. First, he did not demolish the existing system but 'enlisted' it: Bon spirits were not declared false but 'subdued' into Buddhist protectors—the old structure of worship was kept, merely reassigned. The new religion thus grafted onto the old religion's emotional base, avoiding a war of mutual annihilation. Second, he taught in layers by capacity: to the king, the practice of rulers; to translators, doctrine; to disciples, tantra; to common people, refuge and taboo—one teaching existing at different densities, the core (refuge, bodhicitta, emptiness) unchanged. Nyingma literature gives him eight manifestations (the Eight Manifestations of Guru Rinpoche), each matched to a situation—the diversity of forms is itself the methodology on display. Costs and limits: the enlistment strategy invites the charge of opportunism (Bon to this day regards it as cultural colonization); and 'teaching by capacity,' without honest diagnosis, slides into manipulating the audience—what is withheld depends not on their real need but on the transmitter's convenience.
modes.definition_zh: 传播沟通方法论/内核不变而形态随受众改变：先诊断对方的根器、语言与恐惧，再以对方能接受的形态重述同一内核——收编而非替换
modes.definition_en: Dissemination methodology/unchanged core, form adapted to audience: first diagnose capacity, language and fears, then restate the same core in an acceptable form—enlist rather than replace
modes.source_chapter: 《莲花生大师本生传》（邬金岭巴掘藏）；《巴协》（sba bzhed，吐蕃宫廷史料）；宁玛派'咕噜八变'仪轨文献；《如意宝树史》
key_concepts: 调伏 dril bu（以适配而非强制改变对象——传播者担成本而非受众）
收编 enlistment（把对方体系的元素重新委以角色，保留其情感基座）
根器 kapala-capacity（受众消化能力的诊断——分层的依据）
咕噜八变 eight manifestations（同一人的八种形态——形态多样性即方法论）
内核不变 invariant core（皈依、菩提心、空性——所有形态共享的最小集）
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不与雪山之神战，我请他为法护法；我不对牧人说空性，我先教他转经。
modes.key_quote_en: I do not war with the gods of the snows; I ask them to guard the dharma. I do not speak emptiness to herders; I first teach them to turn the prayer wheel.
process_zh: 诊断受众：列出对方的既有体系（信仰、惯例、恐惧、语言）——找出其中不可拆的情感基座与可再利用的结构
决定收编或绕行：对方体系中的元素，凡可重新委以角色者收编（保留外形、替换功能），凡不可收编者绕行而非正面对抗
按根器分层：把同一内核写成不同密度的形态——从最小可接受版本到完整版本，每层都能独立成立且指向同一内核
验证内核不失：任何形态重述后，检查最小集（核心主张）是否仍在——适配是换衣不是换人
process_en: diagnose the audience: map their existing system (beliefs, customs, fears, language)—locate the untouchable emotional base and the reusable structures
choose enlistment or bypass: for each element, either enlist (keep the form, reassign the function) or bypass rather than confront head-on
stratify by capacity: write the one core at different densities—from the minimal acceptable version to the full version, each layer independently valid and pointing to the same core
verify the core survives: after restating in any form, check the minimal set (the core claim) still holds—adaptation changes clothes, not the person
representative_cases_zh: 莲花生入藏沿路'调伏'苯教神灵为护法：念青唐拉、十二丹玛女神等被纳入佛教护法体系——新教法借旧神灵的地方威望落地
对赤松德赞讲王者之道、对桑耶寺译师讲译经规范、对弟子授密续灌顶——同一教法在宫廷、译场、密室三密度并行
桑耶寺'佛苯之诤'后，莲花生主张以实修与仪轨示范代替教义辩论——用对方看得见的效果说话
representative_cases_en: Entering Tibet, Padmasambhava 'subdued' Bon spirits into dharma protectors: Nyenchen Thanglma, the twelve Tenma goddesses and others were enrolled into the Buddhist pantheon—the new teaching landed on the local prestige of the old gods

To Trisong Detsen he taught the way of kings, to the Samye translators the discipline of translation, to disciples he gave tantric empowerment—one teaching at three densities running in court, translation hall and secret chamber
After the Samye 'Buddhism-Bon debate' he favored demonstrative practice and ritual over doctrinal argument—letting effects the other side could see do the speaking
modern_applications_zh: 组织变革中的'旧结构新职能'：流程再造时不废除旧部门而重新委以角色（如把线下渠道改造成体验节点）——降低变革的对抗成本
产品的本地化分层：同一产品内核按市场认知水平提供从简化版到专业版的形态序列——内核不变、密度分层
技术布道中的'收编现有习惯'：新工具嵌入用户既有工作流而非要求推倒重来——把旧习惯调伏为新用法
modern_applications_en: 'Old structures, new functions' in organizational change: don't abolish legacy departments, reassign them (offline channels become experience nodes)—cutting the confrontational cost of change
Localized product tiers: one product core offered as a sequence from simplified to professional by market sophistication—unchanged core, stratified density
Enlisting existing habits in tech evangelism: embed the new tool in the user's current workflow rather than demanding a teardown—subduing old habits into new uses
related_modes: M-PAD-001（伏藏封存法——同一传承设计的两个维度：调伏面向当下受众、伏藏面向未来受众——'按根器适配'的共通原则）
M-PAD-004（双轨并立法——显密双轨是调伏分层的制度化：不同根器走不同轨道而共享同一寺院）
M-PAD-006（灌顶授权法——灌顶是调伏的准入仪式：先诊断根器再决定给什么钥匙）
M-SHA-003（商羯罗·幻相层级法——对照：商羯罗把对方的常识降格为'幻'以保留唯一真理，莲花生把对方的神灵升格为护法以保留情感基座——一个做减法一个做加法）
M-ZZ-002（张载·变化气质法——远缘对照：张载认为气质可变而教化可成，莲花生认为根器可测而说法可变——教化与适配是改造受众的两种方向）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——'调伏'既是其尊号也是其方法：收编苯教、分层说法、八变应机
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—'Subduer' is both his title and his method: enlisting Bon, layered teaching, eight manifestations to meet each situation

representative_figures.relation_zh: 受众侧的样本——莲花生对这位国王的'王者说法'是根器诊断的示范：给掌权者以掌权者能用的修行
representative_figures.relation_en: the sample audience—Padmasambhava's 'teaching for kings' to this monarch exemplifies capacity diagnosis: giving rulers a practice rulers can use

representative_figures.relation_zh: 跨文明平行——利玛窦在明代中国合儒补儒，与莲花生收编苯教同构：以对方体系的情感基座为传播支点
representative_figures.relation_en: the cross-civilizational parallel—Ricci accommodated Confucianism in Ming China as Padmasambhava enlisted Bon: the other system's emotional base as the fulcrum of transmission

name_zh: 能力习得方法论/不把理想人格当作外在楷模去模仿，而在受控的想象修行中直接'生成'其心智状态并暂时认同之——先在心理上成为，再在行为上做出
name_en: capability-acquisition methodology/instead of imitating the ideal figure as an external model, directly generate and temporarily identify with their mental state in controlled contemplative practice—become psychologically first, enact behaviorally second
modes.domain_zh: 本尊瑜伽（devata yoga）是莲花生传入西藏的密法核心，也是他与显教的根本分野。显教的路径是'效仿'：以佛陀为楷模，持戒、修善、渐次趋近——楷模永远在外。本尊瑜伽的路径是'认同'：观修者在灌顶许可下，把自身观想成本尊（如莲花生本人、文殊、观音），从坐姿、服饰、法器到心续，逐一生成，并在禅定中暂认'我即本尊'。其方法论要害有三。其一，把'养成'翻译为'生成'：不是在漫长模仿中逐渐像他，而是在一次观修中直接以他的心理状态运作——慈悲、无畏、洞悉在想象中先被完整调用。其二，受控的认同：灌顶与仪轨设定了认同的边界（进入仪轨、退出仪轨），防止自我与角色的边界永久模糊——这与戏剧方法派的'留在角色里'相反。其三，'生起'与'圆满'次第的配套：先在想象中生成（生起次第），再把生成物连同为生成它的'观想'本身一起消融于空性（圆满次第）——认同被建立又被拆除，防止新的执取。代价与极限：此法对心理素质要求极高，无指导的认同练习会诱发解离或自大（'我即神'的病理化）；且其有效性依赖'心续可被训练'这一前提，对怀疑论者是循环的——观想有效因为心可塑，心可塑由观想有效来证。
modes.domain_en: Deity yoga (devata yoga) is the tantric core Padmasambhava brought into Tibet, and his fundamental parting from exoteric Buddhism. The exoteric path is imitation: the Buddha as model—keep precepts, cultivate good, approach step by step, the model forever outside. The deity-yoga path is identification: with empowerment as license, the practitioner visualizes themselves as the deity (Padmasambhava himself, Manjushri, Avalokiteshvara), generating seat, vestments, implements and mind-stream one by one, and within meditation provisionally accepts 'I am the deity.' Three methodological points are decisive. First, it translates 'cultivation' into 'generation': rather than slowly resembling him through long imitation, one operates directly in his mental state within a single session—compassion, fearlessness and insight invoked in full, in imagination, first. Second, controlled identification: empowerment and liturgy set the boundary of identification (entering and leaving the rite), keeping the self-role border from fusing—the opposite of method acting's 'stay in character.' Third, the pairing of the generation and completion stages: first generate in imagination (generation stage), then dissolve the product together with the visualizing that made it into emptiness (completion stage)—identification is built and then dismantled, guarding against new clinging. Costs and limits: the method demands high psychological robustness; unguided identification practice can induce dissociation or grandiosity (the pathology of 'I am god'); and its efficacy rests on the premise that the mind-stream is trainable, which is circular to the skeptic—visualization works because mind is plastic, and mind's plasticity is proven by visualization working.
modes.definition_zh: 能力习得方法论/以受控想象直接生成理想心智状态并暂时认同，再于次第中拆除认同——'先成为再做出'取代'先模仿后接近'
modes.definition_en: Capability-acquisition methodology/directly generate the ideal mental state in controlled imagination and identify with it provisionally, then dismantle the identification in stages—'become first, act second' replaces 'imitate first, approach later'
modes.source_chapter: 《秘密集会续》（Guhyasamaja Tantra）；《八大法行》仪轨（八epadma修部）；《中阴闻教得度》生起圆满次第章节；宁玛派《大圆满前行引导文》观想章节
key_concepts: 本尊 yidam（被认同的理想心智原型——不是外神而是心性的面向）
生起次第 generation stage（在想象中逐项生成本尊的形态与心续）
圆满次第 completion stage（把生起物连同观想本身消融于空性——认同的拆除程序）
灌顶 abhisheka（认同练习的准入与边界设定——许可、保护与授权）
佛慢 pride of deity（暂认'我即本尊'的心理操作——非病理性的自我扩张）
modes.key_quote_zh: 凡夫见我为外，行者观己为本尊；生起已，当知能观所观俱寂。
modes.key_quote_en: The ordinary person sees the deity as outside; the practitioner beholds themselves as the deity. Having generated it, know that both the beholder and the beheld subside.
process_zh: 选定本尊：按目标心智状态选原型（要勇气选忿怒尊、要慈悲选寂静尊）——原型是能力的拟人化索引
受控进入：以仪式设定认同的边界（空间、时间、姿态），在边界内逐项生成本尊的身、语、意——直到能以其心续运作
在认同中行动：以本尊的心理状态处理真实事务（决策、对话、危机）——行为先于性格改变，因为状态已经切换
次第退出：仪式化地把认同消融于空性，记录'哪些状态带出来了、哪些留在了角色里'——防止自我被角色吞并
process_en: select the deity: choose the archetype by target mental state (wrathful for courage, peaceful for compassion)—the archetype is a personified index of the capability
controlled entry: use ritual to set identification's boundary (space, time, posture), generating the deity's body, speech and mind item by item until you can operate from its mind-stream
act within identification: handle real affairs (decisions, dialogues, crises) from the deity's mental state—behavior changes before character, because the state has switched
staged exit: ritually dissolve the identification into emptiness and record which states were brought out and which stayed in the role—guarding the self from being swallowed by the role
representative_cases_zh: 宁玛派'八大法行'修法：修者依次认同文殊身、莲花语、真实意等八位本尊——把八类能力（智慧、语德、禅定等）拟人化后逐一习得
《中阴闻教得度》的临终指引：引导者教亡者'认出你所见之光明即你自己心性的显现'——本尊认同法在死亡情境的应用：与最恐惧的现象认同而非逃避
莲花生传法仪轨中'咕噜八变'观想：弟子依次观想莲师八种化身——同一人格的八个面向被用作八种心理状态的切换练习
representative_cases_en: The Nyingma Eight Great Sadhana Cycles: practitioners sequentially identify with the eight heruka deities—wisdom, speech, samadhi and other capacities personified and acquired one by one

The Bardo Thodol's deathbed guidance: the dying are taught to 'recognize the light you see as the display of your own mind'—deity yoga applied at death: identify with what most frightens you rather than flee it

The Eight Manifestations visualization in Padmasambhava's liturgies: disciples visualize the eight forms of Guru Rinpoche in turn—eight facets of one personality used as switching practice for eight mental states
modern_applications_zh: 绩效教练的'状态卡位'：高管在关键谈判前花十分钟代入'已解决过一百次此类危机的前辈'的心理状态——本尊瑜伽的世俗化瘦身版
演员与运动员的'角色心锚'：通过固定仪式进入特定心理状态（信心、冷静），并设退出仪式防止角色侵入生活——受控认同的应用
认知行为疗法的'最佳自我想象'：来访者想象并描述'三年后处理此事的理想自我'，练习从该状态的视角回应当下——生成先于养成
modern_applications_en: State-priming in executive coaching: before a crucial negotiation, ten minutes embodying the mental state of 'a senior who has resolved a hundred such crises'—a secular, slimmed-down deity yoga
Role anchors for actors and athletes: fixed rituals to enter a specific mental state (confidence, calm) with exit rituals so the role does not colonize life—controlled identification applied
'Best possible self' imagery in CBT: clients imagine and script their ideal self three years on, practicing responding to the present from that state—generation precedes cultivation
related_modes: M-PAD-006（灌顶授权法——本尊认同的前提制度：灌顶给认同练习发'许可证'并设定边界，无灌顶的认同即失去受控性）
M-PAD-007（中阴导引法——本尊认同法在极限情境的应用：死亡是最强的'角色退出'，中阴导引教人带着认同练习的成果通过它）
M-PAD-008（大圆满直指法——圆满次第的终点：认同物连同观想消融后，直指剩下的那个本然觉性——先建后拆的完整闭环）
M-SHA-004（商羯罗·立敌对论法——对照：商羯罗以论辩拆他方立场，莲花生以认同立自方状态——外部批判与内部生成的对照路径）
M-ATK-003（阿奎那·类比论证法——远缘对照：阿奎那用'类比'谈论不可言说者，本尊瑜伽用'拟人化'习得不可直述的心智状态——都是对语言局限的工程学回应）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型与最高本尊——宁玛派行者以莲师为本尊修认同，其八变人格成为八种心理状态的索引
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype and supreme yidam—Nyingma practitioners identify with Padmasambhava as deity, his eight manifestations indexing eight mental states

representative_figures.relation_zh: 对照路径的承担者——寂护在藏地传显教中观与戒律（外部规范路径），莲花生传密续本尊瑜伽（内部生成路径），双轨互补
representative_figures.relation_en: the bearer of the contrasting path—Shantarakshita taught exoteric Madhyamaka and vinaya (external-norm path) in Tibet as Padmasambhava taught deity yoga (internal-generation path), the two tracks complementary

representative_figures.relation_zh: 跨领域平行——'体验派'表演要求演员在舞台上真实地成为角色，与本尊瑜伽共享'受控认同'的机制，缺的只是空性拆除环节
representative_figures.relation_en: the cross-domain parallel—experiencing-based acting requires truly becoming the character on stage, sharing deity yoga's mechanism of controlled identification, lacking only the emptiness-dismantling step

name_zh: 制度设计方法论/当体系的两种要素（严格规范与直接体验、精英与大众）无法合并时，不裁决孰优而设计两条并行轨道：共享同一门户与终点，各自适配不同人群
name_en: institution-design methodology/when two elements of a system (strict norms and direct experience, elite and popular) cannot be merged, do not adjudicate which wins—design two parallel tracks sharing the same gate and destination, each fitted to its population
modes.domain_zh: 莲花生与寂护在桑耶寺的合作是佛教史上一次罕见的制度设计。寂护传戒律与中观学问（渐修、文本、僧团规范），莲花生传密续实修（灌顶、本尊、直接体验）。两条路径看似冲突——戒律体系警惕密续的越轨意象，密续实践嫌戒律繁琐迟缓——但桑耶寺把它们装进了同一屋檐：显教是'地基'（译经、戒律、学院），密教是'顶层'（密咒殿、灌顶、实修），修行者先受戒、后经遴选才入密续。这就是'显密双轨'：双轨不是妥协而是分工——戒律保底（防止体验狂热滑向放纵），密续给顶（防止规范主义困于形式）。藏传佛教千年稳定的教会结构（宁玛、噶当、萨迦、格鲁无一例外显密兼弘）即从桑耶模板而来。代价与极限：双轨要求清晰的'晋升门槛'，门槛模糊时密续会被误用为捷径（免戒律而直取'大法'）；且双轨并存造成教义解释的双头权威——显教经师与密教金刚师对同一概念的分歧没有仲裁机制时，体系的自洽靠师徒忠诚而非逻辑维持。
modes.domain_en: Padmasambhava's partnership with Shantarakshita at Samye is a rare instance of institutional design in Buddhist history. Shantarakshita transmitted vinaya and Madhyamaka scholarship (gradual path, texts, monastic discipline); Padmasambhava transmitted tantric practice (empowerment, deity yoga, direct experience). The two tracks look conflicting—the disciplinary system wary of tantra's transgressive imagery, tantric practice finding discipline tedious and slow—yet Samye housed both under one roof: exoteric Buddhism as the 'foundation' (translation, ordination, academy), esoteric as the 'summit' (vajra hall, empowerment, practice), practitioners first ordained and only then, after selection, admitted to tantra. This is the dual track: not compromise but division of labor—discipline as floor (keeping experiential fervor from sliding into license), tantra as ceiling (keeping normativism from stalling in form). The millennium-stable ecclesial structure of Tibetan Buddhism (Nyingma, Kadam, Sakya, Geluk, each without exception teaching both) descends from the Samye template. Costs and limits: dual tracks demand a clear 'promotion gate'; when the gate blurs, tantra is misused as a shortcut (skipping discipline to grab 'the great dharma'); and coexisting tracks create a two-headed doctrinal authority—when sutra masters and vajra masters diverge on one concept, with no arbiter the system's coherence rests on master-disciple loyalty rather than logic.
modes.definition_zh: 制度设计方法论/两种必要但互斥的要素不裁决而并行：共享门户与终点、以门槛分层、各轨互为对方的保险——地基与顶层同寺而立
modes.definition_en: Institution-design methodology/two necessary but conflicting elements run in parallel rather than one being adjudicated: shared gate and destination, threshold stratification, each track insuring the other—foundation and summit in one house
modes.source_chapter: 《拔协》（sba bzhed，桑耶寺建寺与顿渐之诤史料）；《娘氏教法源流》；宁玛派教法史中的'显密判教'章节
key_concepts: 显密双轨 sutra-tantra dual track（规范轨与体验轨的并行分工）
桑耶模板 the Samye template（地基-顶层的寺院功能分区）
晋升门槛 promotion gate（入密的遴选条件——双轨防误用的关键）
寂护-莲花生分工 the Shantarakshita-Padmasambhava division（学问僧与瑜伽士的制度化并立）
双头权威 two-headed authority（双轨并存的代价——教义分歧无仲裁）
modes.key_quote_zh: 戒为地，咒为顶；无地者堕，无顶者滞——一寺之内，两轨俱行。
modes.key_quote_en: Discipline is the ground, mantra the summit; without the ground one falls, without the summit one stalls—within one temple, both tracks run.
process_zh: 识别不可合并的要素对：列出体系内'都必要但互相掣肘'的两种要素（规范与体验、质与量、长期与速效）——确认裁决会杀死其中之一
设计共享底座：两条轨道必须共享的门户（准入、价值、术语、终点）先固定下来——差异放在方法层而非目标层
设置晋升门槛：明确从一轨进入另一轨的资格条件与遴选程序——门槛是双轨不被滥用的唯一保险
定期对轨校准：设立双轨代表参与的校准机制，防止两条轨道演化为两个教派——并立的目的是互补而非分家
process_en: identify the unmergeable pair: list the two elements both necessary yet mutually constraining (norms and experience, quality and quantity, long-term and fast)—confirm that adjudication would kill one
design the shared base: fix first what both tracks must share (admission, values, terminology, destination)—differences live at the method level, not the goal level
install the promotion gate: state the qualification and selection procedure for moving from one track into the other—the gate is the only insurance against dual-track misuse
calibrate the tracks periodically: create a calibration mechanism with representatives of both, preventing two tracks from becoming two sects—parallelism aims at complementarity, not schism
representative_cases_zh: 桑耶寺的功能分区：显教经院（译场、戒坛、学院）与密咒殿（灌顶、实修）同寺并立——'地基与顶层'的建筑化制度设计
寂护与莲花生先后受邀入藏：寂护立戒律与学问、莲花生镇伏障碍与传密法——王庭以'两次邀请'完成了双轨的机构化
后弘期诸教派的共同结构：噶当传戒律、萨迦传道果、宁玛传大圆满，但无一不显密兼弘——桑耶模板成为藏传佛教的通用架构
representative_cases_en: Samye's functional zoning: exoteric academy (translation hall, ordination platform, college) and tantric hall (empowerment, practice) standing in one monastery—architecturalized institution design of 'foundation and summit'

Shantarakshita and Padmasambhava invited to Tibet in succession: one established discipline and scholarship, the other subdued obstacles and taught tantra—the court institutionalized the dual track with 'two invitations'

The common structure of the later-dispensation schools: Kadam transmitted discipline, Sakya the path-and-fruit, Nyingma the Great Perfection—yet all taught both sutra and tantra; the Samye template became Tibetan Buddhism's universal architecture
modern_applications_zh: 研发组织的'研究轨与工程轨'：探索性研究与交付性工程并行，共享同一产品愿景与晋升序列，设'研究转工程'的明确评审门槛
双通道职业阶梯：管理轨与专家轨并行且薪酬对等、可互转——避免'人人挤管理独木桥'的单轨扭曲
学校的'学历轨与学徒轨'：学术教育与技能学徒共享毕业资格，设学分互认与转轨机制——双轨包容不同学习风格
modern_applications_en: Research track and engineering track in R&D organizations: exploratory research and delivery engineering in parallel, sharing one product vision and ladder, with an explicit review gate for research-to-engineering transfer
Dual-career ladders: management and expert tracks with pay parity and mutual transferability—avoiding the single-track distortion of 'everyone crowding into management'

Degree track and apprenticeship track in schools: academic and vocational routes sharing graduation credentials, with credit recognition and switching—dual tracks accommodating different learning styles
related_modes: M-PAD-002（顺缘调伏法——双轨是调伏分层的制度化版本：显密两轨即按根器分层的两个稳定容器）
M-PAD-006（灌顶授权法——双轨之间的'晋升门槛'即灌顶：从显入密的资格授予仪式）
M-PAD-005（忿怒镇守法——密续一轨的特色动作：双轨中'顶层'轨以直接体验与威猛方便为特征）
M-NAG-004（龙树·二谛分层法——同构对照：二谛是认知层的双层架构，显密双轨是制度层的双层架构——都以'分层'化解'哪个对'的裁决冲动）
M-MDL-001（门捷列夫·周期表预漏法——远缘对照：门捷列夫为未知元素留空位，桑耶为不同根器留轨道——都拒绝用单一结构装下全部现实）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 双轨中'密续轨'的立法者——在桑耶与寂护分工并立，把体验轨装进规范体系而不被其吞并
representative_figures.relation_en: legislator of the tantra track—working alongside Shantarakshita at Samye, installing the experiential track within the normative system without being absorbed by it

representative_figures.relation_zh: 双轨中'显教轨'的立法者——立戒律与学问地基，并主动推荐莲花生的密续轨补其不足
representative_figures.relation_en: legislator of the sutra track—laid the foundation of discipline and scholarship, and himself recommended Padmasambhava's tantra track to remedy its limits

representative_figures.relation_zh: 双轨的继承整合者（十一世纪入藏）——以《菩提道灯论》把显密次第化：三士道分层，密续为顶层选项
representative_figures.relation_en: the integrator of the dual tracks (arriving in Tibet in the eleventh century)—his Lamp for the Path stratified sutra and tantra: the three-scope gradation with tantra as the top-level option

name_zh: 防御威慑方法论/面对破坏性力量，不否认其能量而收编其形态：以更强大的'忿怒相'出现，把对方的暴力能量导入受控轨道——威慑的本质是能量的接管而非消灭
name_en: deterrence methodology/facing destructive forces, do not deny their energy but conscript their form: appear in an even more powerful 'wrathful aspect' and channel the opponent's violent energy into a controlled track—deterrence is the takeover of energy, not its destruction
modes.domain_zh: 莲花生在藏地叙事中最戏剧性的部分是'镇伏'：他以忿怒相降伏苯教神灵与地方厉鬼，把拒不合作者钉入地基（桑耶寺镇洼的传说）、押为护法。细看这套叙事的方法论内核：其一，忿怒相与慈悲心同体——藏传佛教的忿怒本尊（如莲师的忿怒化身多杰佐烈）面相狰狞而内在是悲心，'忿怒'是对治顽抗的形态切换而非情绪爆发；其二，镇伏的目标是'收编为护法'而非'消灭'——被降伏者获得新岗位，其能量被纳入新体系的秩序；其三，'钉入地基'的意象极重要：破坏性力量不被放逐到体系之外（放逐只意味着边界外的持续威胁），而被固定在体系的最底层、成为体系的承重结构。这构成一种独特的威慑哲学：威慑成功的标志不是对方消失，而是对方的能量为你的体系所用。代价与极限：'忿怒'极易被误读为暴力的正当化——宗教史与政治史上'以威慑之名行消灭之实'的先例不绝；且'收编为护法'的稳定性依赖持续的力量优势，一旦体系衰弱，被'镇伏'者会复起为怨敌（藏史中'赞普灭佛后苯教复起'的结构）。
modes.domain_en: The most dramatic part of Padmasambhava's Tibetan narrative is 'subjugation': in wrathful form he subdued Bon deities and local demons, nailing the recalcitrant into the ground (the legend of subduing the hollows at Samye's foundations) and conscripting them as protectors. The methodological core of this narrative has three parts. First, wrathful face and compassionate heart are one body—the wrathful yidam of Tibetan Buddhism (such as Padmasambhava's wrathful emanation Dorje Drollo) is fearsome in aspect yet compassionate within; 'wrath' is a form-switch to meet defiance, not an emotional outburst. Second, the aim of subjugation is 'conscription as protector,' not annihilation—the subdued receive a new post, their energy absorbed into the new system's order. Third, the image of 'nailing into the foundation' matters: destructive forces are not exiled beyond the system's border (exile means a continuing threat outside it) but fixed at the system's lowest level as its load-bearing structure. This yields a distinctive philosophy of deterrence: the mark of successful deterrence is not the opponent's disappearance but the opponent's energy working for your system. Costs and limits: 'wrath' is easily misread as the justification of violence—religious and political history abound with 'annihilation in the name of deterrence'; and the stability of 'conscription as protector' depends on sustained strength of advantage—once the system weakens, the 'subdued' rise again as enemies (the structure of Bon's revival after the persecuting kings in Tibetan history).
modes.definition_zh: 防御威慑方法论/以更强的忿怒形态接管对方能量并导入受控轨道，收编而非消灭——被镇伏者成为体系的承重结构而非边界外威胁
modes.definition_en: Deterrence methodology/take over the opponent's energy in a more powerful wrathful form and channel it into a controlled track—conscription, not annihilation; the subdued become the system's load-bearing structure, not a threat beyond its border
modes.source_chapter: 《莲花遗教》镇伏章节；宁玛派'多杰佐烈'（忿怒莲师）仪轨；《巴协》桑耶寺建寺传说；'十二丹玛'护法谱系文献
key_concepts: 忿怒相 wrathful aspect（对治顽抗的形态切换——面恶而心悲）
镇伏 subjugation（以更强形态接管对方能量——威慑的本质）
护法 dharmapala（被收编的破坏性力量——获得新岗位）
钉地基 nailing into foundation（把威胁固定为承重结构——不放逐）
悲心为核 compassion as core（忿怒的合法性来源——形态与动机的分离）
modes.key_quote_zh: 以慈悲为骨，以忿怒为面；不灭其力，而改其向。
modes.key_quote_en: Compassion for bone, wrath for face; not destroying the force but redirecting it.
process_zh: 评估对方能量：确认破坏性力量的规模、来源与动员逻辑——镇伏的前提是承认它有真实能量，而非贬低其为'无知'
切换至更强形态：在不越出自身价值内核的前提下，启用对方能感知的最高威慑形态——形态的烈度以'令其停止'为度而非'令其毁灭'为度
导入受控轨道：在对方停止后立即给出新岗位（规则内的角色、可参与的收益）——威慑的收尾是收编而非惩罚
固定为承重结构：把被收编者的利益与新体系的存续绑定——让'反对你'的成本长期高于'为你工作'
process_en: assess the opponent's energy: gauge the scale, source and mobilization logic of the destructive force—subjugation presumes it has real energy, rather than dismissing it as 'ignorance'
switch to the stronger form: without leaving your value core, activate the most deterrent form the opponent can perceive—intensity calibrated to 'make them stop,' not 'make them perish'
channel into a controlled track: the moment they stop, offer a new post (a role within the rules, a share of gains)—deterrence ends in conscription, not punishment
fix as load-bearing structure: bind the conscripted party's interests to the system's survival—make 'opposing you' permanently costlier than 'working for you'
representative_cases_zh: 莲花生入藏途中降伏念青唐拉山神与十二丹玛：以神变镇之、授以护法职——地方最强大的破坏性力量被转为新教法的地方守卫
桑耶寺镇洼传说：拒不服从的厉鬼被钉入佛塔之下——威胁被固定为承重结构，'寺院立于其上'成为秩序意象
忿怒莲师（多杰佐烈）仪轨：修者观修忿怒相以降伏内外障碍——威慑形态先用于自身心理治理，后用于对外威慑
representative_cases_en: Entering Tibet, Padmasambhava subdued the mountain god Nyenchen Thangla and the twelve Tenma: divine displays overawed them and they were appointed protectors—the region's most destructive forces turned into the new teaching's local guards
The Samye hollow legend: demons refusing obedience were nailed beneath the stupas—threats fixed as load-bearing structure, 'the monastery stands on them' as an image of order

The wrathful-Padmasambhava (Dorje Drollo) liturgy: practitioners visualize the wrathful form to subdue inner and outer obstacles—deterrent form used first on one's own psyche, then outward as deterrence
modern_applications_zh: 平台治理的'大V收编'：对最有影响力的批评者不是封禁而是开放共创席位与收益分成——把最大的破坏性能量转为最大的建设性声量
安全体系的'红队常设化'：攻击能力不被驱离而受聘为防御的常设部门——渗透者的能量被导入护法轨道
竞争战略的'威慑+接入'：巨头对潜在颠覆者展示碾压能力后，随即开放平台接口与投资条款——镇伏之后是收编
modern_applications_en: 'VoC conscription' in platform governance: the most influential critics are not banned but offered co-creation seats and revenue shares—the largest destructive energy becomes the largest constructive voice
Standing red teams in security: offensive capability is not driven out but hired as a permanent defense department—the penetrator's energy channeled into a protector track
'Deterrence plus access' in competitive strategy: after demonstrating overwhelming capability to a potential disruptor, open platform APIs and investment terms—subjugation followed by conscription
related_modes: M-PAD-002（顺缘调伏法——同一收编逻辑的柔性与刚性两型：调伏以适配收编、镇伏以威慑收编——共享'给对方新岗位'的落点）
M-PAD-004（双轨并立法——被镇伏的苯教元素最终在双轨体系中获得制度位置：镇伏是收编的第一步，双轨是收编的稳定形态）
M-PAD-003（本尊相应法——忿怒相也是本尊：威慑形态先在受控观修中习得，再用于对外——'先内修后外用'的次序）
M-WZT-010（武则天·无字碑留白法——反向对照：武则天以留白化解敌意叙事，莲花生以收编消化敌意力量——一个取消战场、一个接管战场）
M-LOC-001（洛克·容忍边界法——对照：洛克把破坏性分歧圈在容忍边界外不管，莲花生把破坏性力量收编进体系内用——隔离与接管是两种和平策略）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——忿怒莲师（多杰佐烈）的威慑叙事与镇伏护法的收编实践的直接立法者
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—the direct legislator of the wrathful-Padmasambhava (Dorje Drollo) deterrence narrative and the practice of conscripting the subdued as protectors

representative_figures.relation_zh: 跨领域平行——普奥战争后不割地不赔款、把战败的奥地利收编为潜在盟友：'镇伏的收尾是收编'的世俗执行
representative_figures.relation_en: the cross-domain parallel—after the Austro-Prussian War, no annexation, no indemnity, defeated Austria conscripted as a potential ally: the secular execution of 'deterrence ends in conscription'

representative_figures.relation_zh: 理论亲缘——'被惧怕优于被爱'的威慑逻辑与忿怒镇守法同构，但缺'悲心为核'的合法性约束——形态与动机分离的必要性由此显出
representative_figures.relation_en: the theoretical kinship—'feared over loved' deterrence shares the structure of wrathful subjugation but lacks the 'compassion as core' legitimacy constraint—the necessity of separating form from motive shows here

name_zh: 权限管理方法论/危险能力不公开传授也不私藏，而以'灌顶'仪式分层授权：能力与责任、许可与边界同授——授钥匙的同时授说明书与安全带
name_en: permission-management methodology/dangerous capabilities are neither published openly nor hoarded, but tiered through the 'empowerment' rite: capability, responsibility, license and boundary conferred together—with the key come the manual and the seatbelt
modes.domain_zh: 灌顶（abhisheka）是密续体系最独特的制度发明。莲花生把印度密续的灌顶制度带入西藏并系统化：弟子须依次获得宝瓶灌顶、秘密灌顶、智慧灌顶、词义灌顶，每一级对应一层教法与修法的准入。其方法论内核是'能力与许可的绑定'：密法不是知识而是操作——如同核材料，它的传授须同时完成三件事，授能力（教你怎么做）、授许可（授权你做）、授边界（限定你在哪里做、出了事谁负责）。仪轨本身即安全机制：灌顶前的'根器检验'是准入审查，灌顶中的誓言（三昧耶）是责任签署，灌顶后的'守护誓言'是持续合规。这套设计回应一个普遍难题：有效能的东西都有危险性，而组织对危险能力的处理常犯两种错——完全封锁（能力无法扩散、体系停滞）或完全公开（能力被误用、事故频发）。灌顶制度的答案是第三条路：分层授权加绑定责任。代价与极限：门禁制度必然产生权威垄断——'谁有权灌顶'成为教团的权力核心，历史上灌顶授权的腐败与派系化从未断绝；且'誓言'的约束力依赖成员的信仰承诺，对不认誓言者形同虚设——门禁防得住误会者，防不住伪装者。
modes.domain_en: Empowerment (abhisheka) is the tantric system's most distinctive institutional invention. Padmasambhava brought India's empowerment system into Tibet and systematized it: disciples must receive in sequence the vase, secret, wisdom and word empowerments, each tier gating a stratum of teaching and practice. Its methodological core is the binding of capability to license: tantra is not knowledge but operation—like fissile material, its transmission must accomplish three things at once: confer capability (teach you how), confer license (authorize you to act), confer boundary (define where, and who is accountable). The rite itself is the safety mechanism: the capacity check before empowerment is admission screening; the vows (samaya) during it are a signed responsibility; the vow-keeping after it is continuous compliance. This design answers a general problem: everything effective is dangerous, and organizations typically err in two ways with dangerous capability—total lockdown (capability cannot spread, the system stalls) or total openness (misuse and accidents abound). The empowerment system's answer is a third way: tiered authorization with bound responsibility. Costs and limits: gatekeeping inevitably produces authority monopoly—'who may empower' becomes the order's power center, and the corruption and factionalism of empowerment lineages never ceased; and vows bind only the committed—to those who disregard them they are void: the gate stops the mistaken, not the masquerading.
modes.definition_zh: 权限管理方法论/危险能力以分层仪式授权：能力、许可、责任、边界四件同授——既不全封也不全开，门禁与安全带一体
modes.definition_en: Permission-management methodology/dangerous capability authorized through tiered rites: capability, license, responsibility and boundary conferred as one—neither total lockdown nor total openness; gate and seatbelt in one
modes.source_chapter: 《大圆满龙钦心髓前行》灌顶章节；宁玛派'四灌顶'仪轨文献；《秘密集会续》灌顶品；莲师《誓言尊与智慧尊》开示
key_concepts: 灌顶 abhisheka（能力+许可+边界的捆绑授予仪式）
四灌顶 four empowerments（宝瓶/秘密/智慧/词义——能力分层的 graduated keys）
三昧耶 samaya（灌顶时签下的责任条款——违规的代价被预先声明）
根器检验 capacity check（准入审查——授权前的资格核验）
门禁悖论 gatekeeper paradox（门禁产生权威垄断——制度自身的权力代价）
modes.key_quote_zh: 未授之钥不开未备之门；授钥之时，誓与钥俱下。
modes.key_quote_en: An unbestowed key opens no unready door; when the key is given, the vow descends with it.
process_zh: 给能力定危险级：评估目标能力的伤害半径与可逆性——危险级决定授权的层级数与门禁强度
设计分层钥匙：把能力拆解为可逐级授予的层级，每级配对应的训练、许可与操作范围——不授完整钥匙给未备之人
捆绑责任签署：每次授权同时签下使用边界与违规后果——让获得能力者在获得时就了解责任的全部重量
设置持续合规：授权不是一次性事件——建立定期复检、吊销机制与同伴监督，让许可处于'持续有效'而非'永久持有'状态
process_en: rate the capability's danger: assess harm radius and reversibility—danger class determines the number of tiers and gate strength
design tiered keys: decompose the capability into grantable levels, each with its training, license and operating range—never a full key to the unready
bind signed responsibility: every grant carries its usage boundary and consequences—so the newly capable learn the full weight of responsibility at the moment of gaining capability
install continuous compliance: authorization is not one-off—periodic re-checks, revocation and peer oversight keep the license 'currently valid' rather than 'permanently held'
representative_cases_zh: 莲花生为赤松德赞等'君臣二十五弟子'分层灌顶：按各自根器授予不同层级的修法许可——同一师门、不同权限
四灌顶次第制度：宝瓶（身）→秘密（语）→智慧（意）→词义（心性直指）——最危险的'心性直指'放在最高层级并配最重誓言
《前行引导文》要求灌顶前完成出离心、菩提心等前行训练——授权前的强制训练是门禁的一部分而非可选项
representative_cases_en: Padmasambhava gave tiered empowerment to the 'twenty-five disciples' of the king and court: practice licenses granted by each one's capacity—one master, different permissions

The four-empowerment sequence: vase (body) → secret (speech) → wisdom (mind) → word-meaning (direct pointing at mind-nature)—the most dangerous 'direct pointing' sits at the top tier with the heaviest vows
The Ngondro preliminaries require renunciation and bodhicitta training before empowerment—mandatory pre-authorization training as part of the gate, not an option
modern_applications_zh: 安全行业的分级权限体系：root 权限、生产环境变更权、密钥访问权分层授予并绑定审计与吊销——'能力与责任同授'的工程实现
医疗的处方权制度：麻醉药品、化疗药物的处方资格须经培训、考核与定期再认证——分层授权加持续合规
AI 系统的能力分级部署：模型能力按危险级分层开放（API 审核、红队测试、部署配额）——灌顶逻辑在通用技术上的翻版
modern_applications_en: Tiered privilege in security engineering: root, production-change and key-access rights granted in tiers, bound to audit and revocation—the engineering realization of 'capability and responsibility conferred together'
Prescription authority in medicine: credentials for anesthetics and chemotherapy require training, examination and periodic recertification—tiered authorization with continuous compliance
Capability-tiered AI deployment: model capabilities opened by danger class (API vetting, red-teaming, deployment quotas)—the abhisheka logic transposed to general technology
related_modes: M-PAD-003（本尊相应法——灌顶授权的对象正是认同练习：没有边界设定的认同是心理危险品，灌顶是它的安全带）
M-PAD-004（双轨并立法——灌顶是显密双轨之间的晋升门槛：双轨制度的安全阀）
M-PAD-007（中阴导引法——中阴导引本身是'词义灌顶'层级的知识：最深的导引只授予完成全部层级者）
M-AQU-001（阿奎那·信仰与理性分层法——远缘对照：阿奎那给教义分'理性可证/须启示'两层并各配方法，灌顶给密法分四级并各配许可——都以分层管理知识的危险度）
M-HAY-001（哈耶克·自发秩序法——反向对照：哈耶克警惕一切人为门禁对扩散的阻碍，灌顶制度相信无门禁的扩散必致灾难——知识扩散的放任与门禁之争）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——把印度密续灌顶制度系统化并移植入藏的立法者，'君臣二十五弟子'的分层授权是其示范
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—legislator who systematized India's empowerment rites and transplanted them to Tibet; the tiered authorization of the 'twenty-five disciples' as his demonstration

representative_figures.relation_zh: 被授权者的样本——王者受灌顶的历史实例：授权同时意味着王室对密法滥用的连带责任
representative_figures.relation_en: the sample recipient—the historical case of a king receiving empowerment: the grant simultaneously bound the crown to liability for misuse of tantra

representative_figures.relation_zh: 现代平行——曼哈顿计划的密级与知情分层是灌顶逻辑的国家版：危险能力的分层授权加终身责任
representative_figures.relation_en: the modern parallel—Manhattan Project classification and need-to-know as the state's version of abhisheka: tiered authorization of dangerous capability with lifetime responsibility

name_zh: 危机过渡方法论/把最剧烈的状态转换（死亡、失业、迁徙、组织重组）预先分解为可识别的阶段序列，为每个阶段预写导引：'此刻你会见到X，认出它，不要逃，做Y'
name_en: crisis-transition methodology/decompose the most violent state transitions (death, job loss, migration, reorganization) in advance into an identifiable sequence of stages, pre-writing guidance for each: 'here you will see X—recognize it, do not flee, do Y'
modes.domain_zh: 《中阴闻教得度》（俗称《西藏度亡经》）是莲花生伏藏体系最著名的产出：一部为'死亡'这一最剧烈的过渡状态预写的导航手册。其方法论结构极为清晰。其一，阶段化：把死亡至转生的过程分解为临终中阴（地光明现前）、实相中阴（本尊与光焰显现）、投生中阴（业力牵引寻找托生处）等阶段——每个阶段有可识别的'路标'。其二，预告：在当事人还清醒时完整预演一遍——'你将先看到什么，那不是外部而是你自己'。其三，核心动作是'认出'（rigpa 的认识）：所有恐怖的显现（忿怒尊、巨响、光明）被预告为'你自己的心的投射'——认出即解脱，恐惧即流转。这部手册的深层洞察是：过渡态的痛苦主要不是来自事件本身，而是来自'不认识发生了什么'——把未知预告为已知，把陌生态预告为'你早见过'，恐惧就失去大部分能量。代价与极限：导引预设了'阶段序列是固定的'——若实际经验不按剧本出现（现代安宁疗护观察到的死亡经验与文化剧本高度相关），手册就成了误导；且'认出即解脱'把全部重量压在当事人当下的觉知上——对昏迷、失智或恐慌者，手册无力，需要代理决策者按其意愿代行。
modes.domain_en: The Bardo Thodol (the 'Tibetan Book of the Dead') is the most famous output of Padmasambhava's terma system: a navigation manual pre-written for death, the most violent of transitions. Its methodological structure is strikingly clear. First, staging: the passage from death to rebirth is decomposed into the bardo of dying (ground luminosity dawning), the bardo of reality (deities and lights appearing), the bardo of becoming (karmic pull seeking rebirth)—each stage with recognizable 'landmarks.' Second, preview: while the person is still lucid, the whole sequence is rehearsed—'this is what you will see first; it is not outside you but your own mind.' Third, the core act is 'recognition' (recognizing rigpa): all terrifying appearances (wrathful deities, thunderous sounds, radiant light) are announced in advance as 'projections of your own mind'—to recognize is liberation, to fear is wandering. The manual's deep insight: the suffering of transition comes less from the event itself than from 'not knowing what is happening'—announcing the unknown as known, the alien state as 'you have seen this before,' and fear loses most of its energy. Costs and limits: the guidance presumes a fixed stage sequence—when experience departs from the script (modern hospice observation shows death experiences track cultural scripts closely), the manual misleads; and 'recognition is liberation' puts the entire weight on the person's present awareness—for the comatose, demented or panicking, the manual is powerless and a proxy must act on their behalf.
modes.definition_zh: 危机过渡方法论/把剧烈过渡预先分解为带路标的阶段序列并逐段预写导引——把'不认识发生了什么'的恐惧替换为'认出'的行动
modes.definition_en: Crisis-transition methodology/decompose violent transitions in advance into stages with landmarks, pre-writing guidance for each—replacing the fear of 'not knowing what is happening' with the act of 'recognizing'
modes.source_chapter: 《中阴闻教得度》（Bardo Thodol，噶玛林巴伏藏）；《六中阴教导》（莲师传措嘉伏藏文献）；《大圆满中阴愿文》
key_concepts: 中阴 bardo（两个稳定状态之间的过渡带——被系统化的'液态区间'）
阶段路标 stage landmarks（每阶段可识别的征兆——导航的前提）
预告 preview（清醒时的完整预演——把未知替换为已知）
认出 recognition（'这是我自己'——导引的核心动作）
文化剧本 cultural script（导引的有效性依赖经验与剧本的匹配——手册的边界）
modes.key_quote_zh: 尊贵的某某，谛听：你所见的焰光，非自外来——是你自心之光明；认出它，即是解脱。
modes.key_quote_en: O noble one, listen: the radiance you see comes not from outside—it is the light of your own mind; to recognize it is liberation.
process_zh: 列全过渡的阶段：把目标过渡（死亡、重组、失业）分解为依次出现的阶段，为每阶段写下可识别的征兆——没有路标就没有导航
预写逐段导引：对每阶段预写三行——'你会见到什么'、'它是什么'、'此刻做什么'；导引须短促可直接执行（当事人在过渡态认知资源极低）
在清醒时完整预演：当事人在状态稳定时通读全程剧本并演练关键动作——预演的价值在于让'剧本'进入肌肉记忆
指定在场导引人：过渡发生时由导引人依剧本逐段提示——导引人须熟记全部路标，且提前获得当事人对每个动作的预授权
process_en: enumerate the transition's stages: decompose the target transition (death, reorganization, job loss) into successive stages with recognizable signs for each—no landmarks, no navigation

pre-write per-stage guidance: for each stage write three lines—'what you will see,' 'what it is,' 'what to do now'; guidance must be brief and executable (cognitive resources are minimal in transition)
rehearse in full while lucid: the person reads the whole script and drills the key moves while stable—rehearsal works by putting the script into procedural memory
appoint the on-scene guide: in transition a guide prompts stage by stage per the script—the guide must know every landmark and hold pre-authorization for each action
representative_cases_zh: 《中阴闻教得度》的完整结构：临终→实相→投生三中阴，每段配'你会见到什么/那是什么/如何应对'的口传导引——死亡导航手册的完整样本
宁玛派'六中阴'教法：把生处、梦境、禅定、临终、实相、投生全部纳入中阴框架——过渡态被系统性扩张为'人生的主要地形'
现代安宁疗护对《度亡经》的借鉴：预告性谈话（anticipatory guidance）与临终导引的实践——中阴方法在世俗临终关怀中的转译
representative_cases_en: The Bardo Thodol's full structure: three bardos—dying, reality, becoming—each with oral guidance of 'what you will see / what it is / how to act,' the complete sample of a death navigation manual
The Nyingma 'six bardos' teaching: birth, dream, meditation, dying, reality and becoming all brought under the bardo frame—transition states systematized as 'the main terrain of life'
Modern hospice's borrowing from the Bardo Thodol: anticipatory guidance and bedside death-navigation practice—the bardo method translated into secular end-of-life care
modern_applications_zh: 企业并购的'整合中阴手册'：把重组期分解为宣布→震荡→重组→固化四阶段，每阶段预写'你会看到什么（流言、离职潮、指标波动）与该做什么'——把未知的恐慌预演为已知
个人职业过渡的'离职剧本'：辞职前写好'第一个月你会感到什么/什么时候最危险/何时联系谁'——为自己预写导引
灾难应急的'阶段卡片'：地震、火灾的求生指南按'最初10秒/1分钟/10分钟'分段并配明确动作——过渡态认知极低时的预写导引
modern_applications_en: The 'integration bardo manual' in M&A: decompose the reorganization into announce → shock → restructure → consolidate, pre-writing 'what you will see (rumors, departures, metric wobble) and what to do'—rehearsing the unknown into the known
The personal 'exit script' for career transitions: before resigning, write 'what month one will feel like / when it is most dangerous / whom to call when'—pre-writing your own guidance

Staged cards in disaster response: survival guides for earthquake and fire broken into 'first 10 seconds / 1 minute / 10 minutes' with explicit actions—pre-written guidance for when cognition is minimal
related_modes: M-PAD-001（伏藏封存法——中阴导引正是伏藏体系的旗舰产出：为'未来的每个人'预写的导引，由伏藏师在四百年后掘出）
M-PAD-003（本尊相应法——中阴导引的'认出本尊'环节以本尊认同的日常训练为前提：生前未练，死后认不出）
M-PAD-006（灌顶授权法——中阴导引属于最高层级授权的知识：它的效力依赖当事人对导引者的预先信任授权）
M-SHA-006（商羯罗·亲证检验法——对照：商羯罗要求亲证作为真理标准，中阴导引要求生前预演作为死亡通行证——都拒绝把关键检验推迟到无法补考的时刻）
M-ST-001（斯多亚·消极想象法——同构对照：斯多亚人每天预演失去（premeditatio malorum）以消解恐惧，中阴导引把预演推向极限情境——预告未知是共同的解恐惧机制）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——中阴教法的传法者与伏藏作者：把死亡从'未知的深渊'改写为'有路标的过渡带'
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—transmitter and terma author of the bardo teachings: rewriting death from 'unknown abyss' into 'transit corridor with landmarks'

representative_figures.relation_zh: 导引文本的保存者——莲师教授的中阴与多数伏藏经其记忆并封存，'导引人'角色的原型实践者
representative_figures.relation_en: the preserver of the guidance texts—Padmasambhava's bardo teachings and most termas were memorized and sealed by her, the prototype practitioner of the 'guide' role

representative_figures.relation_zh: 现代平行——把死亡过程阶段化（否认/愤怒/讨价还价/抑郁/接受）并教导陪伴者按阶段应对——中阴阶段化的世俗重现
representative_figures.relation_en: the modern parallel—staging the dying process (denial, anger, bargaining, depression, acceptance) and teaching companions to respond by stage—the secular return of bardo staging

name_zh: 根本认知方法论/终极认识不是逐级修出来的而是被指出的：师者以一句直指让弟子'认出'本自具足的觉性，其余修法只是守护这个认出——获得先于努力
name_en: foundational-epistemology methodology/the ultimate recognition is not achieved stepwise but pointed out: the master's single direct introduction lets the disciple 'recognize' the already-present awareness, and all further practice merely guards that recognition—acquisition precedes effort
modes.domain_zh: 大圆满（dzogchen）是莲花生传给西藏弟子的最高教法，其方法论与整个'修'的常识相反。常识认为：认识是渐修的产物——先做A再做B最终得到C。大圆满断言：觉性（rigpa）本自现前、从未缺失，修行不能'制造'它只能'认出'它；师的职责不是教导而是'直指'（ngo desp）——在弟子心识开放的一刻（惊愕、大笑、施压后的松弛、或一声断喝），直接指着说'此刻那个能知者，即是'。认出之后的一切修法（且却立断、妥噶顿超）都只是'不丢失'这个认出的守护与扩展。这一结构的方法论含义深远：其一，把'学习'从加法改为减法——不是获得新能力而是拆除遮蔽（'云不是天空，天空从未被云损毁'）；其二，把师徒关系的重心从'传授'移到'指出'——师知道弟子已具备，师的全部工作是制造让弟子看见自己已具备的契机；其三，'认出先于修'颠倒了通常的能力论——不是熟练导致自信，而是认出（确知本具）才使修不退转。代价与极限：'直指'完全依赖师者的准头与弟子的开放度——直指错位（弟子把念头或感受误认为觉性）会造成难以纠正的错误确认；且'本自具足'若被浅读为'无需努力'，大圆满就沦为懒惰的合法化——传统对此的纠正极严：认出之后恰是'守护比修更难'的警告。
modes.domain_en: Dzogchen, the highest teaching Padmasambhava transmitted to his Tibetan disciples, runs against the common sense of 'practice.' Common sense: recognition is the product of gradual cultivation—do A, then B, finally obtain C. Dzogchen asserts: awareness (rigpa) is already present, never lost; practice cannot manufacture it, only 'recognize' it; the master's task is not instruction but 'direct introduction' (ngo desp)—at the moment the disciple's mind is open (a shock, laughter, the release after pressure, or a sudden cry), pointing straight and saying: 'that which knows, right now—this is it.' All practice after recognition (trekcho, togal) merely guards and extends it, never loses it. The methodological implications run deep. First, learning shifts from addition to subtraction—not acquiring a new capacity but removing obscuration ('clouds are not the sky; the sky was never damaged by clouds'). Second, the master-disciple relation's center of gravity moves from 'transmission' to 'pointing out'—the master knows the disciple already has it, and the master's whole work is creating the occasion for the disciple to see that they already have it. Third, 'recognition precedes practice' inverts the usual theory of competence: not mastery producing confidence, but recognition (the certainty of what is innate) making practice non-regressing. Costs and limits: direct pointing depends entirely on the master's accuracy and the disciple's openness—a misdirected introduction (the disciple mistaking a thought or feeling for awareness) creates an error hard to correct; and 'already complete,' shallowly read as 'no effort needed,' turns Dzogchen into the legitimization of laziness—the tradition's correction is severe: after recognition, precisely the warning that 'guarding is harder than practicing.'
modes.definition_zh: 根本认知方法论/觉性本自具足、修行只是认出：师的工作不是传授而是制造让弟子看见'我本具足'的契机——获得先于努力，守护重于获取
modes.definition_en: Foundational-epistemology methodology/awareness is innate and practice merely recognizes it: the master's work is not transmission but creating the occasion for the disciple to see 'I already have it'—acquisition precedes effort, guarding outweighs gaining
modes.source_chapter: 《大圆满椎击三要》（措嘉记录莲师开示）；《无垢光尊者七宝藏》（龙钦巴）；《且却与妥噶》宁玛派口传文献；《声应成续》
key_concepts: 觉性 rigpa（本自现前、从未缺失的根本觉知——被认出而非被制造）
直指 ngo desp（师在心识开放一刻的直接指出——传授让位于指出）
椎击三要 three statements（直指、唯于此中决断、于中解脱自信）
立断 trekcho（拆除遮蔽的减法修行——非获得新能力）
守护 guarding（认出之后的全部功课——'守护比修更难'）
modes.key_quote_zh: 云散时方见晴空，然晴空非云散所造——觉性亦然：非修所成，唯为认出。
modes.key_quote_en: Only when clouds part do you see the clear sky, yet the sky was not made by their parting—so with awareness: not made by practice, only recognized.
process_zh: 确信'已在'：先审查目标（觉性、天赋、领导力）是否真的本自具足而非可制造——若非本具，此法不适用，改用渐修法
制造契机而非讲课：师不铺陈理论，而设计让对象'亲眼看见自己已具备'的瞬间（高压后的松弛、意外的惊愕、直指的提问）——契机指向'看'，不指向'学'
当场确认：在契机发生的当下，请对象确认'就是此刻这个'——确认要具体（那能听、能知、不随念头走的），防止错认念头为觉性
转入守护：认出之后切换模式——不再追加新知识，而是设计让认出不丢失的日常（短而频的回认、情境触发器、同伴互查）
process_en: confirm it is innate: first examine whether the target (awareness, talent, leadership) is truly already present rather than manufacturable—if not innate, this method does not apply; switch to gradual cultivation

create occasions, not lectures: the master lays out no theory but designs moments for the object to 'see for themselves they already have it' (release after pressure, sudden shock, a pointing question)—the occasion points at seeing, not studying

confirm on the spot: at the moment of the occasion, have the object confirm 'just this, now'—confirmation must be specific (that which hears, knows, and does not follow thoughts), preventing mistaking a thought for awareness

shift to guarding: after recognition, change modes—no new knowledge is added; instead design daily routines that keep the recognition (brief frequent re-recognitions, situational triggers, peer checks)
representative_cases_zh: 莲师'椎击三要'：以'直指本觉→于此决断→解脱自信'三句完成从认出到守护的完整路线——大圆满方法论的浓缩立法
传统公案中的'直指'时刻：弟子问'什么是佛'，师答'你问话的那个是谁'——把寻求者当场转向寻求者自身，认出'能问者即所要找的'
《七宝藏》对'错认'的系统排查：龙钦巴列出把念头、空感、乐受误认为觉性的十余种歧途——直指法的纠错清单
representative_cases_en: Padmasambhava's 'three statements that strike the vital point': 'direct introduction to awareness, decisive confidence therein, confidence in liberation therein'—the condensed legislation of the route from recognition to guarding

The 'direct pointing' moment in classic koans: asked 'what is Buddha,' the master answers 'who is the one asking?'—turning the seeker on the spot toward the seeker, recognizing 'the one asking is what is sought'
The Seven Treasures' systematic survey of misrecognition: Longchenpa lists over a dozen cul-de-sacs of mistaking thoughts, blankness or bliss for awareness—the pointing method's error checklist
modern_applications_zh: 导师制的'直指式反馈'：不铺陈理论，而是在学员真实工作的高压后松弛一刻直接指出'你刚才的处理就是这种能力本身'——让学员确认而非学习
产品设计的'功能已存在'原则：先确认用户'本自具足'的工作流，再做减法移除遮蔽它的环节（而非叠加新功能）——大圆满减法在界面上的应用
组织人才盘点中的'已具备优先'：把高潜人才的问题从'缺什么培训'改为'其已有的哪项能力未被组织看见与使用'——先认出再配置
modern_applications_en: Direct-pointing feedback in mentoring: no theory-laying; instead, at the release right after a stretch assignment, point straight: 'what you just did is the capability itself'—having the learner confirm rather than learn

The 'capability already exists' principle in product design: first confirm the workflow users innately have, then subtract the steps obscuring it (rather than adding features)—Dzogchen subtraction applied to interfaces

'Already-have-first' in talent review: change the question for high potentials from 'what training is missing' to 'which existing capability does the organization fail to see and use'—recognize first, then deploy
related_modes: M-PAD-003（本尊相应法——生起次第的'造'与直指的'认'构成大圆满的前后两翼：先在想象中生成本尊，最终认出观者本身不需生成）
M-PAD-007（中阴导引法——中阴导引的'认出光明即自心'正是直指法的临终应用：生前认得熟，死后才认得出）
M-PAD-006（灌顶授权法——直指是最高层级的'词义灌顶'内容：最直接的教导配最重的门槛与誓言）
M-SHA-001（商羯罗·不二还原法——深层对照：商羯罗的'你即梵'（tat tvam asi）与大圆满直指结构同源——都是'终极认识是被指出的而非修成的'；分野在于商羯罗以经典为权威源头，大圆满以师者的当下直指为源头）
M-ZZ-001（张载·大心体物法——远缘对照：张载'大其心则能体天下之物'以扩展心量达于万物一体，大圆满以认出本具觉性达于显空不二——两个'心本来够大'的传统）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——把大圆满教法传入西藏并留下'椎击三要'的直指立法者
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—the introducer of Dzogchen into Tibet and legislator of the 'three statements that strike the vital point'

representative_figures.relation_zh: 直指法的系统整理者（十四世纪）——《七宝藏》把直指、错认排查与守护次第编为完整学理
representative_figures.relation_en: the systematizer of direct pointing (fourteenth century)—the Seven Treasures codified introduction, error-survey and guarding into a full doctrine

representative_figures.relation_zh: 跨文明同构——'知识已在、师者接生'的产婆术与直指法共享'先在性+指出者'结构
representative_figures.relation_en: the cross-civilizational isomorph—'knowledge is already there, the teacher midwifes' shares the innate-plus-pointer structure with direct introduction

name_zh: 离场设计方法论/创始人在离场时刻不交代日常而下达预言：把体系的未来风险、对手与转机一并封入对后世的'预记'中，让离场本身成为最后一次战略部署
name_en: exit-design methodology/at the moment of leaving, the founder issues not instructions but prophecy: sealing the system's future risks, adversaries and turns into 'foretellings' for posterity, making departure itself the final strategic deployment
modes.domain_zh: 莲花生离藏前（约八世纪末）的行为是其方法论中最后一环：他不做权力交接（他没有可交接的职位），不做财产分割，而是留下'莲师预记'（banana lugs kyi lung bstan）——对西藏未来数百年的一系列预言：末法之相、王统之乱、法难将至、何时何地将有何种人物出兴。这些预言的方法论功能与其字面真假是两回事。作为战略文档，预记完成了三件事：其一，风险预告——把'体系会遇到的坏情况'预先写进集体记忆，坏情况发生时组织有现成的解释框架而不至于溃散；其二，人员期待——预记中'某时将有某德出兴'为关键岗位的继任者准备了'被期待的位置'（伏藏师、大译师的出现都有预记背书）；其三，权威转移——预记把'未来的解释权'从创始人个人转交给'符合预记描述的事件'，体系在创始人离场后仍有一个可运转的合法性引擎：不是'他说了'而是'预记中的应验了'。代价与极限：预记的模糊性是双刃剑——足够模糊的预言总能找到应验（冷读效应），体系因此既获得韧性也丧失了证伪能力；且预记一旦被权力集团垄断解释，就从风险预警退化为政治工具。
modes.domain_en: Padmasambhava's behavior on leaving Tibet (c. late eighth century) is the final link of his methodology: he conducted no handover (he held no office to hand over), divided no property, but left the 'prophetic testaments' (lung bstan) attributed to him—a series of predictions for Tibet's coming centuries: signs of degeneration, dynastic disorder, coming persecution, what persons will appear when and where. The prophecies' methodological function is a separate question from their literal truth. As strategic documents they accomplished three things. First, risk pre-announcement: writing 'the bad things the system will meet' into collective memory in advance, so that when they occur the organization has a ready interpretive frame and does not collapse. Second, personnel anticipation: 'at such a time such a worthy will appear' prepared the 'expected slot' for key successors—the emergence of tertön and great translators came prophecy-backed. Third, transfer of authority: the prophecies moved 'the right to interpret the future' from the founder as a person to 'events matching the prophecies,' leaving the system an operating legitimacy engine after his exit—not 'he said' but 'the prophecy was fulfilled.' Costs and limits: the vagueness of prophecy cuts both ways—vague enough predictions always find fulfillment (the cold-reading effect), so the system gains resilience and loses falsifiability at once; and once an interpretation monopoly over prophecy falls to a power bloc, it degenerates from risk warning to political instrument.
modes.definition_zh: 离场设计方法论/创始人以预言完成最后部署：预先写下体系将遇的风险、继任者的画像与转机的条件——离场不是撤出而是把解释权移交给自己写好的未来
modes.definition_en: Exit-design methodology/the founder completes the final deployment with prophecy: pre-writing the risks the system will meet, the profile of successors and the conditions of renewal—departure is not withdrawal but handing interpretive authority to a future of one's own writing
modes.source_chapter: 《莲花遗教》末章预言；《五部遗教》之《国王遗教》；娘热伏藏中的莲师授记文献；宁玛派教法史所辑'莲师预记'汇编
key_concepts: 预记 lung bstan（对体系未来的书面预言——离场的战略文档形式）
风险预告 risk pre-announcement（坏情况入册——组织遇乱时有现成解释框架）
继任画像 successor profile（预记中的'某时某德'——为关键岗位准备被期待的位置）
应验即权威 fulfillment as authority（合法性从'他说'移到'应验'——解释权的物化转移）
冷读风险 cold-reading risk（预言模糊则必然应验——韧性与不可证伪的同价）
modes.key_quote_zh: 吾去之后，法将遇难，王统将乱；然有伏藏师于某地出兴，法脉不断——汝等勿忧，预记已在。
modes.key_quote_en: After I go, the dharma will meet persecution and the dynasty disorder; yet a revealer will appear in such a place and the lineage will not break—do not fear: the prophecy stands.
process_zh: 在离场时点切换文档类型：从'操作手册'切换到'预记'——日常交给制度，只有制度无法覆盖的'未来风险与转机'才写进预记
写风险清单而非许诺清单：预记的主体是'会发生什么坏事'（法难、分裂、失传）——组织对坏消息的提前免疫比对好消息的期待更有价值
给继任者留'画像槽位'：用可识别的特征描述未来需要的人（'生于某地、具某德'），让筛选有方向而不锁定具体人名
设计应验的确认程序：预先约定'什么算应验、由谁确认'——没有确认程序的预记会在第一代后就沦为任意解释
process_en: switch document type at exit: from 'operations manual' to 'prophecy'—routines go to institutions; only the future risks and turns institutions cannot cover enter the prophecy

write a risk list, not a promise list: the prophecy's body is 'what bad things will happen' (persecution, schism, loss)—an organization's pre-immunization against bad news outranks its anticipation of good news
leave a 'profile slot' for successors: describe the needed person by recognizable traits ('born in such a place, having such virtue')—giving selection direction without locking a name

design the fulfillment-confirmation procedure: agree in advance 'what counts as fulfillment and who confirms'—prophecy without a confirmation procedure degenerates into arbitrary interpretation within one generation
representative_cases_zh: 莲师'末法预记'：朗达玛灭佛（842年）发生后，藏地僧团援引莲师预记把灾难纳入解释框架——预记为灭法后的复兴准备了心理与组织韧性
伏藏师的'出兴预记'：每位伏藏师的出现都被追溯到莲师授记——继任者画像槽位使掘藏传统在无中央权威下延续了七百年
《国王遗教》对王统乱象的预言：把政治风险写入宗教文献——风险预警被编入体系记忆而非仅存于宫廷档案
representative_cases_en: Padmasambhava's 'degeneration prophecies': when Langdarma's persecution struck (842), Tibetan clergy invoked the prophecies to fit disaster into an interpretive frame—pre-immunizing the revival that followed

The tertön 'appearance prophecies': every treasure revealer's emergence traced back to Padmasambhava's authorization—the successor profile slot kept the extraction tradition running seven centuries without central authority
The Royal Testament's prophecies of dynastic disorder: political risk written into religious literature—risk warnings compiled into the system's memory, not just court archives
modern_applications_zh: 创始人'离场备忘录'：创始人在卸任前写下'公司未来十年最可能遇到的三种危机与应对原则'，封存于董事会——预记作为风险预警的治理化
基金的'情景预记'：投资备忘录预先写明'若发生X则触发Y'（对赌、回购条款）——把预言写成条件触发的合约条款
开源项目的' Maintainer 预记'：原作者在 README 中写明'当本项目遇到无人维护时，具备这些特征的人可接手'——继任画像槽位的开源实践
modern_applications_en: The founder's 'exit memorandum': before stepping down, write 'the three likeliest crises of our next decade and the principles of response,' sealed with the board—prophecy as governance risk warning
'Scenario pre-records' in venture: term sheets pre-write 'if X occurs then Y triggers' (ratchets, buybacks)—prophecy written as condition-triggered contract clauses

'Maintainer prophecy' in open source: the original author states in the README 'should this project go unmaintained, one with these traits may take over'—the successor profile slot, open-source edition
related_modes: M-PAD-001（伏藏封存法——预记与伏藏是一体两面：伏藏封存'物'、预记封存'期待'——时间分层传承的完整设计）
M-PAD-010（感恩托付法——离场的两种书写：预记写风险、托付写感恩——战略文档与情感文档的分工）
M-PAD-004（双轨并立法——预记中的继任画像保护的是双轨体系的延续：门禁制度若无预记背书，权威断裂即体系断裂）
M-NAG-010（龙树·感恩收束法——对照：龙树以'我稽首礼佛'把权威归还源头、以传承链收束，莲花生以预记把权威投向未来——向后归源与向前投递是收束的两个方向）
M-BORG-003（博尔赫斯·重写即读法——远缘对照：博尔赫斯让'重写'成为文本生命的方式，预记让'应验'成为体系生命的方式——都以'未来的重新解读'为文本的续命机制）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——离藏时以系列预记完成最后部署，使无职位的创始人获得了超越在场的战略存在
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—completing the final deployment with prophecies on leaving Tibet, winning a founder without office a strategic presence beyond his presence

representative_figures.relation_zh: 反面教材——预言的模糊性使其被任意解读而丧失战略功能：'无确认程序的预记沦为冷读'的警示样本
representative_figures.relation_en: the cautionary parallel—prophecy's vagueness invited arbitrary reading and forfeited strategic function: the warning case of 'prophecy without confirmation procedure degrades into cold reading'

representative_figures.relation_zh: 现代平行——库克时代'乔布斯会怎么做'的持续引用，本质是把创始人的预判封为组织的解释框架——预记功能的世俗版
representative_figures.relation_en: the modern parallel—the perpetual citation of 'what would Steve do' in the Cook era effectively seals the founder's foresight as the organization's interpretive frame—the secular prophecy function

name_zh: 传承收束方法论/体系的完成者不居立法之名：以感恩把成果归还源头（师承、传承链、众生），以托付把体系交给后人——'我只是取宝的人'是最彻底的收束姿态
name_en: legacy-closure methodology/the completer of a system claims no legislative title: with gratitude the fruits return to their source (masters, lineage, all beings), with entrustment the system passes to successors—'I was only the one who fetched the treasure' as the most thorough closure
modes.domain_zh: 莲花生在西藏的全部建树——镇伏、传法、封藏、预记——最终都被他自己叙述为'代取'：教法来自印度师承（他自述师从八大持明者），成就归于佛陀与空行母的护持，伏藏'属于'未来掘出它的弟子。这种叙述不是谦辞而是收束技术。其一，归源防神化：把体系锚定在'传承链'而非'个人'上——莲花生本人也讲'我的上师比我伟大'，体系的权威被分散到链条的每一环，任何单点的神圣化都被源头稀释；其二，托付防断绝：'宝藏属于掘宝人'的框架把未来的传承者从'继承者'变为'行使者'——后人不是接受遗赠的弱方，而是按契约来取的强势方，传承因此获得了心理上的主动性；其三，感恩的仪式功能：伏藏文献开篇几乎必有对师承与护法的礼敬（'顶礼上师'），礼敬不是装饰而是'把注意力从作者导向链'的仪式装置。代价与极限：彻底的归源可能使体系的'当下贡献者'不可见——'都归功于传统'的叙事若被滥用，就为抹除当代劳动提供修辞；且托付给'未来掘宝人'的框架依赖后人的自我认同，若后人拒绝进入角色，托付落空，体系仍须面对无主的危险。
modes.domain_en: Everything Padmasambhava built in Tibet—subjugation, teaching, concealment, prophecy—he himself finally narrated as 'fetching on behalf of': the teaching came from his Indian lineage (he named his eight vidyadhara masters), the accomplishment belonged to the Buddha's and dakinis' support, and the terma 'belonged' to the future disciples who would unearth them. This narration is not humility rhetoric but closure technique. First, returning to source prevents deification: anchoring the system on the 'lineage' rather than the person—Padmasambhava himself said 'my gurus surpass me'—disperses authority along every link of the chain, and any single-point sanctification is diluted by the source. Second, entrustment prevents rupture: the frame 'the treasure belongs to its revealer' changes future successors from 'heirs' into 'executors'—not the weaker party receiving a bequest but the stronger party coming to claim under contract, giving transmission psychological initiative. Third, the ritual function of gratitude: terma literature opens almost invariably with homage to lineage and protectors ('homage to the guru')—not ornament but a ritual device 'redirecting attention from author to chain.' Costs and limits: thorough source-return can render the system's present contributors invisible—the narrative 'all credit to tradition,' if abused, supplies rhetoric for erasing contemporary labor; and entrustment to 'future revealers' depends on successors' self-identification—should they decline the role, the entrustment fails and the system still faces the danger of being unowned.
modes.definition_zh: 传承收束方法论/以感恩把成果归还源头传承链、以托付把体系交给作为'行使者'的后人——体系的完成者自认'取宝人'而非立法者
modes.definition_en: Legacy-closure methodology/return the fruits to the source lineage with gratitude and hand the system to successors as 'executors'—the completer claims 'treasure-fetcher,' not legislator
modes.source_chapter: 《莲花遗教》发愿与回向章节；伏藏文献通例之'顶礼上师'开篇；《益西措嘉佛母传》所载莲师临别嘱咐；宁玛派'上师相应法'文献
key_concepts: 归源 return to source（成果归还师承与传承链——权威分散到链条每一环）
托付 entrustment（后人从继承者变为行使者——传承的主动性设计）
取宝人叙事 the fetcher narrative（'我只是代取'——完成者的自我定位）
顶礼开篇 the homage opening（礼敬作为'注意力导向链'的仪式装置）
链权威 chain authority（合法性由链条而非单点承载——防神化的机制）
modes.key_quote_zh: 法非我造，乃自师承；藏非我有，乃待后人——我只是雪域的取宝人。
modes.key_quote_en: The dharma is not mine but my lineage's; the treasure is not mine but awaits posterity's hand—I am only Tibet's treasure-fetcher.
process_zh: 在完成时点做'贡献归属审计'：逐项列出体系成果中属于传承、属于协作、属于时代机缘、属于本人的份额——审计本身即防神化的第一步
以归源叙述重写成果文本：把'我发明了X'改写为'依师传之X，于此地新境中显发'——保留贡献事实、变更权威结构
设计托付契约：明确后人以什么身份接手（行使者而非继承人）、接手时获得什么义务（守护条件、再传责任）——托付是双向契约而非单向遗赠
以感恩仪式收束：为体系开篇与结尾安置礼敬文本，使'注意力从作者导向链'制度化——让每一次被阅读都是一次归源
process_en: run a contribution-attribution audit at completion: itemize which shares of the system's fruits belong to lineage, collaboration, circumstance and oneself—the audit itself is step one against deification
rewrite the fruits' texts in source-returning narrative: 'I invented X' becomes 'following my masters' transmission of X, unfolded in this new terrain'—facts kept, authority structure changed

design the entrustment contract: define in what capacity successors take over (executor, not heir) and what obligations come with it (keeping conditions, re-transmission duty)—entrustment is a two-way contract, not a one-way bequest
close with gratitude rites: install homage texts at the system's opening and end, institutionalizing 'attention directed from author to chain'—every future reading becomes an act of source-return
representative_cases_zh: 莲花生自述'八师承'：把自己的密法成就归功于八位印度持明上师——藏传最显赫的成就者把权威锚定在链条而非自身
伏藏文献的通例结构：以'顶礼上师、空行、护法'开篇，以'愿此藏利益未来有情'回向收尾——感恩与托付的文本制度化
莲师对益西措嘉的临别嘱咐：'法已托付，藏已封存，汝为守护者非拥有者'——托付契约的口头立法样本
representative_cases_en: Padmasambhava's 'eight masters' self-account: he credited his tantric attainment to eight Indian vidyadhara masters—Tibet's most illustrious adept anchoring authority on the chain, not himself

The formulaic structure of terma literature: opening homage to 'guru, dakinis and protectors,' closing dedication 'may this treasure benefit future beings'—gratitude and entrustment institutionalized in text
Padmasambhava's parting charge to Yeshe Tsogyal: 'the dharma is entrusted, the treasures sealed; you are their guardian, not their owner'—the oral legislation sample of the entrustment contract
modern_applications_zh: 学术著作的'归源致谢'：把概念谱系（谁先提出、谁在哪里显发）在正文与致谢中显式声明——归源审计的学术版
开源项目的'维护者交接契约'：原作者退位时写明接手者的权利与义务（分支权、命名权、再分发责任）——托付契约的工程版
家族企业的'第三代行使者'设计：把继承者的身份从'遗产接收人'改为'事业的现任行使者'并对下一代负有同等义务——托付的代际化
modern_applications_en: 'Source-returning acknowledgments' in scholarship: explicit statements of conceptual lineage (who first proposed, who unfolded where) in text and acknowledgments—the academic attribution audit

The 'maintainer handover contract' in open source: on stepping aside, the original author writes the successor's rights and duties (fork rights, naming rights, redistribution duties)—the engineering entrustment contract

'Third-generation executor' design in family enterprise: the heir's identity shifts from 'bequest recipient' to 'incumbent executor of the undertaking,' owing the same duties to the next generation—entrustment made generational
